FIELDS.NAME: The Golf Shoppe
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
The Golf Shoppe specializes in the retail of high-quality golf and sporting equipment, catering to amateur and professional athletes, as well as recreational players. Our store is committed to providing a comprehensive selection of golfing gear, apparel, accessories, and other sporting goods, while prioritizing a safe and organized shopping environment. We operate under the strict policy of not engaging in equipment rentals or repair services on customer-owned items, thereby minimizing our liability exposure. Our premises are well-maintained, clean, and equipped with a professionally monitored alarm system to enhance security. We focus solely on products that align with our goal of promoting safe and enjoyable sports experiences, avoiding high-risk items such as firearms, explosives, or any hazardous materials. Our staff is trained in safety protocols, ensuring a risk-aware culture that contributes to a positive customer experience.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any rental operations of sporting equipment and confirms that sales of firearms and ammunition account for less than 5% of total annual receipts. Additionally, we do not provide repair services on customer-owned equipment and have a professionally monitored alarm system in place to ensure safety and security.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: The Golf Shoppe LLC - a golf and sporting goods retail store focusing on high-quality products, with no rental, repair, or high-risk sales operations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 08/15/2023, a storm caused water damage to a portion of our store's inventory, resulting in an estimated loss of $1,500. The cleanup and restitution process has been completed, and we have since taken measures to prevent future incidents. The claim was submitted to the insurer and is currently marked as resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Class B Safe, UL Listed, 2 Hour Fire Resistance, with Electronic Lock.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Professionally monitored alarm system, fencing around the premises, and regular security patrols.

FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – The Golf Shoppe does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as we focus exclusively on the retail sale of golf and sporting equipment while prioritizing safety and compliance.
